disputes.a: All 18 spots; the 100% checklist separately stops at 15 of 18.
disputes.b: Some coverage quotes 'only 15 of 18 are needed' without separating trophy from checklist.
disputes.call: Our call: 18 for the trophy, 15 for the checklist — both numbers shown.
disputes.topic: How many meditations does the trophy need?

disputes.a: Unconfirmed — it raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a meditation spot.
disputes.b: The guide author who earned the trophy had done the balcony meditation first.
disputes.call: Our call: unresolved; do it in Chapter 1 anyway — caution, not fact.
disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?

disputes.a: About 200 hours (60–80 story, ~100 checklist, ~10 cleanup).
disputes.b: Up to 300 hours or more.
disputes.call: Our call: plan for ~200 h; the dissenting 300 h figure stays on the roadmap.
disputes.topic: Time to platinum

disputes.a: Complete the final mission (the official description's own wording).
disputes.b: Worded by some outlets as completing Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Our call: the official description is used verbatim in the checklist.
disputes.topic: The final mission trophy's framing
disputes.trophy: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

disputes.a: All trophy quest givers are available again after the story — nothing is missable.
disputes.b: A single secondary report says the five stranger chains have story-linked windows.
disputes.call: Our call: both claims shown; chains sit on Watch, not Missable, until a second witness settles it.
disputes.topic: Do stranger chains have story windows?

disputes.a: Individual values printed by some lists (e.g. A Long Road 100G).
disputes.b: Other roundups note the values do not match list to list and decline to print them.
disputes.call: Our call: print PSN points only (300/90/30/15 by grade, 1,350 total).
disputes.topic: Xbox Gamerscore per trophy

disputes.a: The trophy description says complete 250 stunts.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist line asks for 300 stunts.
disputes.call: Our call: 250 pops the trophy; 300 is the checklist's separate ask.
disputes.topic: 250 stunts or 300?

disputes.a: The trophy asks for 50 completed challenges.
disputes.b: The checklist counts 70 of 80 challenges toward 100%.
disputes.call: Our call: both true, different counters — the guide labels which is which.
disputes.topic: 50 challenges or 70 of 80?

disputes.a: Golds accumulate across visits; each range keeps its best medal.
disputes.b: One roundup implies a range's medals reset between sessions.
disputes.call: Our call: accumulated — no source with a played range supports a reset.
disputes.topic: Do range golds need one sitting?

disputes.a: A win at every one of the 14 locations.
disputes.b: An aggregator phrases it as 14 total drone-race wins.
disputes.call: Our call: per location, matching the official description's wording.
disputes.topic: Wins per location or total wins?

disputes.a: 20 different races, as the description states.
disputes.b: A checklist summary shortens it to 'win 20 races'.
disputes.call: Our call: different races — repeat wins are not counted in YOUR COUNT.
disputes.topic: Different races or any 20 wins?

disputes.a: The in-game Progress > Stats list is the authority, thresholds included.
disputes.b: Roundups publish differing checklist totals for discoveries and challenges.
disputes.call: Our call: follow the in-game list; roundup totals are shown as estimates.
disputes.topic: What does the 100% checklist actually require?

disputes.a: Kenton pauses after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3.
disputes.b: A missables roundup lists Kenton among Chapter 1 losses.
disputes.call: Our call: a pause, not a lock — it sits on the timeline as 'pauses, does not lock'.
disputes.topic: Is Kenton's pause a missable lock?

disputes.a: Yes — the description says lose the level with your partner.
disputes.b: A forum summary suggests solo clears after duo crimes count.
disputes.call: Our call: keep the pair together until the stars are gone.
disputes.topic: Must both partners be present when the heat clears?

disputes.a: No — 'without losing your Wanted Level' spans the whole chain.
disputes.b: One guide reads each shop as its own separate attempt.
disputes.call: Our call: one unbroken chain of three, as the description reads.
disputes.topic: Can the wanted level dip between shops?

disputes.a: Five vault robberies with escapes; reset vaults count again.
disputes.b: The fuller guide implies five distinct vaults.
disputes.call: Our call: unconfirmed either way — the guide routes five distinct vaults to be safe.
disputes.topic: Do repeat vaults count?

disputes.a: 9 gangs, one operation each.
disputes.b: A list roundup counts 8 gang territories.
disputes.call: Our call: 9, following the sources that name the operations.
disputes.topic: How many gangs are there to hit?

disputes.a: 52 named areas lift the map's grey.
disputes.b: An aggregator says 48 districts.
disputes.call: Our call: 52 areas, counted on the map itself, not districts.
disputes.topic: How many areas make 'all of Leonida'?

disputes.a: Entering a model registers the discovery.
disputes.b: Coverage of the scanning system suggests a scan also counts.
disputes.call: Our call: enter to be certain; treat scans as a bonus, not the method.
disputes.topic: Does entering or scanning discover a vehicle?

disputes.a: PSN tracks the counter to 500 across choices of all kinds.
disputes.b: One roundup claims only story choices advance it.
disputes.call: Our call: all choices — the tracker note says side content is needed to reach 500.
disputes.topic: What fills the 500-choice counter?

disputes.a: No deadline is stated; totals accumulate across the run.
disputes.b: A summary hints unlaundered bills expire at chapter ends.
disputes.call: Our call: launder promptly anyway; no source proves an expiry.
disputes.topic: Must marked bills be laundered the same day?

disputes.a: 8 garage properties carry this trophy.
disputes.b: Property roundups fold safehouses into a larger count.
disputes.call: Our call: 8 garages only; safehouses are a different purchase class.
disputes.topic: Are there 8 garages or more properties?

disputes.a: A maximum-heat tank encounter, survived.
disputes.b: The description is a joke line; no played account pins the trigger.
disputes.call: Our call: labelled unconfirmed (confidence C) — experiment at high heat.
disputes.topic: What is the Rhino trigger, exactly?

disputes.a: A night event in the interior wilds, repeatable across nights.
disputes.b: One list treats it as a one-time scripted story beat.
disputes.call: Our call: unconfirmed; the guide presents it as a free-roam night watch.
disputes.topic: Is the strange sighting scripted or random?

disputes.a: A partner interaction performed before a gathered crowd.
disputes.b: A roundup guesses a photo or social moment with the pair.
disputes.call: Our call: unconfirmed (confidence C); both guesses are shown, neither asserted.
disputes.topic: What partnership moment has 'mass appeal'?

disputes.a: Any repeatable attempt failed once then passed immediately.
disputes.b: A summary narrows it to race restarts only.
disputes.call: Our call: unconfirmed scope — the guide offers a challenge first, a race as fallback.
disputes.topic: Which attempts qualify for second-try success?
